newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Makhteshim in accord with Dow.
newsitem.headline: Makhteshim in accord with Dow.

text.p: Israel's Makhteshim Chemical Works Ltd has signed an agreement with Dow Chemical Co giving Makhteshim exclusive rights to distribute and produce vinyl esters in Israel, Makhteshim said on Tuesday.
The product line could yield $1.5 million in annual sales, managing director Shlomo Yonas said in a statement.

The company said Dow views Makhteshim, the world's largest maker of general agro-chemicals, as a potential production and marketing centre for its products in the Middle East. However, a Makhteshim spokeswoman said the present deal was confined to Israel.
"There is a possiblity to do it in the Middle East but not yet," she said.
Dow accounts for half of the worldwide production of vinyl ester resins, which protect against corrosive chemicals.
Makhteshim, a subsidiary of Israel's Koor Industries, had revenues of $416 million in the first nine months of 1996.
